paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of TFLOPS for several models. The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPS”, employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 1e7 to 9e8, with tick intervals of 1e8. The y-axis, labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, spans from approximately 94% to 100%, with tick intervals of 2%. A solid purple line represents the loss ratio for Vanilla, starting at approximately 97% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 99% at 8e8 TFLOPS. A solid orange line denotes the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64), beginning at approximately 96% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 98% at 8e8 TFLOPS. A solid blue line represents the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=128), starting at approximately 96% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 99% at 8e8 TFLOPS. A solid green line indicates the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64, H), beginning at approximately 95% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 99% at 8e8 TFLOPS. Finally, a solid red line signifies the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64, T/H), commencing at approximately 95% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 99% at 8e8 TFLOPS.
